اضطرعوا (form VIII)
# اِضْطَرَعُوا (iḍṭaraʕū) /idˤ.tˤa.ra.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
# اِضْطَرِعُوا (iḍṭariʕū) /idˤ.tˤa.ri.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
